actors.name: Juno
examples: Ask me properly or don't ask.

actors.name: Theo
examples: It's not finished. It might never be.

actors.name: Priya
examples: I don't care who you kiss. I care who finds out.

items.name: Pressed black shirt
items.description: Makes you look like you belong behind the bar.

items.name: Silver cufflinks
items.description: Fidgeting with them buys you a second to think.

items.name: Dark jeans
items.description: Broken in, forgiving, fine for a double shift.

items.name: Scuffed boots
items.description: Comfortable enough to stand in for four hours.

items.name: Unlabelled mixtape
items.description: Side A is somebody's whole summer. Carrying it makes you braver, somehow.

items.name: Little brass key
items.description: Stamped VR-JB. Too small for a door.

items.name: Signed jazz single
items.description: A 1962 pressing, signed in green ink by a pianist nobody remembers except Theo.

items.name: Bent lucky coin
items.description: Someone hammered a heart into it. It turns up heads more than it should.

items.name: Priya's old waistcoat
items.description: Too good for the bar. Priya says that is the point.

items.name: Theo's spare pick
items.description: Worn smooth on one side. He has twelve; this one he gave you.

items.name: Quiz-night pen
items.description: Chewed. Lucky. Returns right answers at a better rate than chance.

items.name: Bag of good limes
items.description: Seville, waxed, the ones Juno swears by.

items.name: Enamel swallow brooch
items.description: Flea-stall find. The blue has chipped exactly right.

items.name: Set of bronze strings
items.description: Theo has been playing on the same set since spring.

items.name: Dog-eared songbook
items.description: Standards, pencilled chord changes in three hands.

items.name: Garage-forecourt roses
items.description: Cellophane, a price sticker, sincere intentions.

activities.name: Work a shift with Juno
activities.description: Four hours of orders, spills and Juno correcting your pour. Forty in tips and wages.

activities.name: Do the open mic
activities.description: Five minutes on the tiny stage. Your hands shake; nobody throws anything.

activities.name: Do the cryptic crossword
activities.description: An afternoon of anagrams and cold coffee.

activities.name: Help Priya with the stock count
activities.description: Crates, clipboards and Priya's running commentary on everyone who works here.

activities.name: Sit by the piano
activities.description: You nurse one drink and listen to Theo play the whole set.

activities.name: Stay after closing
activities.description: Chairs up, lights down, Juno counting the till.

activities.name: Walk Theo home
activities.description: The long way, past the canal.

activities.name: Do the market run with Juno
activities.description: Limes, mint, ice, and Juno arguing prices she has already decided on.

activities.name: Busk with Theo
activities.description: An upturned hat, a borrowed tambourine, and strangers who walk past without looking.

activities.name: Rehearse lines in the mirror
activities.description: Twenty minutes of saying hard things to your own face until they come out easier.

activities.name: Read on the fire escape
activities.description: A paperback, a mug, the city humming below. You notice more about people afterwards.

activities.name: Haggle at the stalls
activities.description: You talk a fishmonger down two quid and make him laugh doing it.

activities.name: Watch the boats and feed the swans
activities.description: Narrowboats, a heron, and one swan with a clear grudge. You find yourself guessing at every passer-by's story.

activities.name: Join the quiz on the barge
activities.description: The barge café runs a quiz at dusk. Your team is two pensioners and a dog; you come second.

activities.name: Pick a song on the jukebox
activities.description: You feed it a coin and choose something that makes the regulars sing along.

signals.label: a gift you picked for her
a morning at the market together
a gift you picked for him

scriptedScenes.title: First night
scriptedScenes.opening: Your first night at the Velvet Room.

choices.label: Give Juno a line back
choices.result: "I can do one of those. Your choice which." Juno actually laughs, then pretends she didn't.

fail.result: Your comeback arrives about three seconds late. Juno pats your shoulder. "We'll work on it."

choices.label: Ask the pianist what he's playing
choices.result: Theo stops mid-bar. "Nobody asks. It's mine. It's not finished." He plays it again, slower, for you.

fail.result: You ask while he's mid-phrase. He answers politely and switches to a standard.

effects.reason: he was glad to be asked

choices.label: Just get to work
choices.result: You carry crates. Priya nods once, which you gather is high praise.

scriptedScenes.title: Saturday rush
scriptedScenes.opening: Three deep at the bar, and Juno is enjoying watching you drown.

choices.label: Flirt back without missing an order
choices.result: "You'd make a lovely emergency exit." You slide the negronis out on time. Juno's grin lasts the rest of the shift.

fail.result: You try a line and pour tonic into the wrong glass. Juno fixes it without looking. "Keep trying. Both things."

choices.label: Keep your head down and pour
choices.result: You survive the rush. Juno says "Not bad" on the way out, which feels like a medal.

scriptedScenes.title: Chairs up
scriptedScenes.opening: The bar is dark except for the till light. Juno counts, slowly.

choices.label: Tell her you've been thinking about her
choices.result: You say it plainly. Juno puts the cash bag down, comes around the bar, and stops close enough that it's a question.

modifiers.label: You've held your own with her
She told you about Last Orders

fail.result: It comes out as a joke about the till. Juno laughs, but she looks at you a beat too long. "Try that again sometime. Properly."

choices.label: Just help her count
choices.result: You count in silence. It's comfortable, which is almost worse.

beats.opening: Juno, very close, waiting to see what you do.

choices.label: Kiss her
choices.result: She kisses you back like it's a competition she intends to win. Somewhere behind you, the staff-room light is on.

choices.label: "Not here. Not yet."
choices.result: Juno nods, surprised, and — you think — pleased. "Then I'll hold you to 'yet'."

scriptedScenes.title: Properly
scriptedScenes.opening: Another close. Juno hasn't forgotten.

choices.label: Say it properly this time
choices.result: You don't joke. Juno takes your collar and pulls you in, and doesn't let go for a long time.

fail.result: You get halfway. Juno finishes the sentence for you, then kisses your cheek. "Halfway counts. Barely."

choices.label: Tell her you're not ready
choices.result: "Fair." She means it. She also pours you a drink, which she never does.

scriptedScenes.title: The unfinished song
scriptedScenes.opening: Last set. Theo plays something that isn't on the list.

choices.label: Tell him it sounds like missing someone
choices.result: Theo is quiet for a long time. "Eight months," he says. "You're the first person who heard it."

effects.text: The player heard the unfinished song and knew what it was about.

modifiers.label: You asked about it on your first night

fail.result: "It's lovely," you say. Theo smiles the smile he gives tippers and closes the lid. Still — he saw you stay for the whole set.

choices.label: Say nothing; ask him to play it again
choices.result: He plays it again. You don't talk. When he stops, he looks at you like you passed a test you didn't know you were taking.

scriptedScenes.title: Last song
scriptedScenes.opening: Closing time. Theo is still at the piano, not playing.

choices.label: Sit beside him on the bench
choices.result: You sit. Your shoulder touches his. He plays the ending wrong on purpose so he can start again.

fail.result: You hover, then take the stool beside the bench instead. Theo laughs softly. "You can sit here, you know." Next time, you will.

choices.label: Say goodnight
choices.result: "Goodnight," Theo says, and plays the ending to the empty room.

scriptedScenes.title: The long way
scriptedScenes.opening: The canal path, streetlights on the water, Theo walking slower than he needs to.

choices.label: Tell him he's allowed, and kiss him
choices.result: He kisses you like he's been composing it for weeks. When he pulls back, he's laughing. "I think I've got the ending."

fail.result: You both lean in and both stop. Theo kisses your cheek instead, embarrassed and glad. "Same time next week?"

choices.label: Tell him there's no rush
choices.result: Theo exhales like he's been holding it for eight months. "Thank you. Really."

scriptedScenes.title: The staff-room window
scriptedScenes.opening: Priya is waiting by the ice machine.

choices.label: Ask Priya to keep it between you
choices.result: Priya weighs it. "Fine. You owe me a Saturday." She means it, and she'll keep her word.

modifiers.label: You helped with the stock count

fail.result: "Sure," Priya says, in the tone of someone who has already told two people. By Thursday, the whole bar knows — Theo included.

choices.label: Tell her it isn't a secret
choices.result: Priya shrugs. "Your funeral." When Juno hears you said it out loud, she goes quiet for a whole shift.

scriptedScenes.title: "So. You and Juno."
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo, between sets, not quite looking at you.

choices.label: Tell him the truth
choices.result: Theo nods slowly. "Thank you for not making me guess." It hurts him a little. It doesn't break anything.

choices.label: Tell him it was nothing
choices.result: Theo believes you, and relaxes, and you'll have to live with that.

fail.result: You hesitate one second too long. Theo sees it. "Right," he says, and goes back to the piano. He doesn't play the unfinished song that night.

scriptedScenes.title: Off the clock
scriptedScenes.opening: Your flat. Juno kicks the door shut behind her and looks around like she is pricing the furniture.

choices.label: Take the lead
choices.result: You don't wait for her to set the pace. Juno laughs, low and surprised, and lets you win for once.

fail.result: You go for it and catch your elbow on the bookshelf. Juno laughs so hard she has to sit down, then pulls you down with her. "Next time, mean it," she says, and you learn she wants you to.

choices.label: Let her set the pace
choices.result: Juno takes over the way she takes over a busy bar: fast, sure, a little showing off. She is watching to see if you will ever push back.

choices.label: Ask her to slow right down
choices.result: Juno tries it your way for about a minute, then sits back on her heels. "This isn't us tonight." It fizzles, kindly. You both know she wanted a contest.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: Juno stops at once. "Then we stop." She finds your kettle without asking and puts it on. It is not awkward; she makes sure of that.

beats.opening: Juno pulls back an inch, breathing hard, and looks at you properly.

choices.label: "Very." And mean it
choices.result: She grins like she just won something.

choices.label: Ask what she wants next
choices.result: She tells you, in detail, and dares you to keep up. It turns out she likes it as a contest.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: Juno stops at once. "Then we stop." She finds your kettle without asking and puts it on. It is not awkward; she makes sure of that.

beats.opening: Somewhere past midnight. The kettle is forgotten.

choices.label: Keep it a contest to the end
choices.result: Neither of you gives an inch. Later she admits it was the best shift she has had all year.

choices.label: Slow it down at the end
choices.result: It is sweet, and she lets it be. She is already thinking about next time, and what she will do differently.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: Juno stops at once. "Then we stop." She finds your kettle without asking and puts it on. It is not awkward; she makes sure of that.

scriptedScenes.title: Slow
scriptedScenes.opening: Your flat, one lamp on. Theo sits on the edge of the bed with his jacket still on, which you decide is funny and not sad.

choices.label: Go slow, and watch for when he goes quiet
choices.result: You catch every pause before it becomes a wall and ask with a look, not a question. Theo stops apologising.

modifiers.label: He trusted you with the song

fail.result: You misread a pause and ask if he's okay at exactly the wrong moment. Theo laughs into your shoulder. "Yes. Ask again later, though."

choices.label: Ask him what he wants, out loud
choices.result: He has to think about it, and then he tells you, and saying it seems to cost him less each time.

choices.label: Pick up the pace
choices.result: Theo keeps up for a while, then goes somewhere behind his eyes. You notice too late. "Sorry," he says, which is worse. It ends early and gently.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: "Okay." Theo breathes out, and you both laugh at how relieved he sounds. He stays anyway, shoes off, jacket finally off, and falls asleep mid-sentence.

beats.opening: Theo goes quiet, eyes shut, very still.

choices.label: Ask, softly, if he is still with you
choices.result: "Yeah." He opens his eyes. "Thank you for asking. Keep asking."

choices.label: Keep going; he'd say if not
choices.result: He does not say. He takes a while to come back. You both notice.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: "Okay." Theo breathes out, and you both laugh at how relieved he sounds. He stays anyway, shoes off, jacket finally off, and falls asleep mid-sentence.

beats.opening: The lamp, the quiet, and Theo finally not apologising for anything.

choices.label: Stay slow, all the way
choices.result: Slow, careful, good. Afterwards he hums something you haven't heard before.

choices.label: Let him set the ending
choices.result: He surprises you both. Afterwards he laughs at the ceiling for a full minute.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: "Okay." Theo breathes out, and you both laugh at how relieved he sounds. He stays anyway, shoes off, jacket finally off, and falls asleep mid-sentence.

scriptedScenes.title: Regular
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno lets herself in this time. Her boots are off before the door shuts.

choices.label: Surprise her
choices.result: You do something she hasn't seen coming, and for once Juno has nothing smart to say. She spends the rest of the night trying to get even.

fail.result: You try the same move as last time and she sees it coming a mile off. "Predictable," she says, and pins you anyway. It is still good. She is still waiting to be surprised.

choices.label: Let her set the pace
choices.result: Fast and sure, like closing time. Good, familiar. Juno looks at you afterwards as if she is deciding something.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: "Fine by me." Juno pulls her boots back on and steals your last beer on the way out. "Tomorrow, then. Or not. Your call."

scriptedScenes.title: Quiet
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo takes his jacket off at the door this time, and looks pleased with himself about it.

choices.label: Let him say what he wants, in his own time
choices.result: You wait through the quiet instead of filling it, and what he asks for surprises both of you. Afterwards he is the one who talks, for an hour, about nothing.

modifiers.label: You know how to sit with a bad night

fail.result: You wait a beat too long and he takes it for doubt. It takes a while to find each other again, but you do. "Still learning me," he says. It sounds like a compliment.

choices.label: Ask him what he wants, out loud
choices.result: He answers quicker than last time. Slow, careful, good, and he stays for breakfast.

choices.label: Say you want to stop here
choices.result: "Okay. Can I stay anyway?" He does, and hums the half a verse into the pillow until he falls asleep.

scriptedScenes.title: Lime prices
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno is at the fruit stall with a crate under one arm, losing an argument she is pretending to win.

choices.label: Out-haggle the lime man
choices.result: You invent a competing stall two streets over. The lime man folds. Juno looks at you like you just did a card trick.

fail.result: The lime man sees through you in one sentence. Juno laughs at you all the way back to the bar, which is somehow better.

choices.label: Take the crate off her
choices.result: "I had it." She lets you carry it anyway, and tells you which stallholders are crooks on the way back.

scriptedScenes.title: Flea market
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno is already at the car-park end with two coffees. She hands you one without looking and points at a lamp.

choices.label: Break her rules and work the stallholders with her
choices.result: You play the soft touch to her hard sell. By ten you own a lamp, two stools and a mirror for less than the lamp was. Juno kisses you behind the coffee van like it is part of the haggle.

effects.plan: Meet Juno at the flea market tomorrow morning

fail.result: You smile at the lamp man. The price doubles. Juno buys it anyway, then makes you carry it home and tells everyone at the bar.

effects.plan: Meet Juno at the flea market tomorrow morning

choices.label: Keep quiet and carry
choices.result: You follow her rules. She wins every argument and you carry every prize. It is a very good morning.

effects.plan: Meet Juno at the flea market tomorrow morning

scriptedScenes.title: Tomorrow, nine
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno slides a coaster over with a time on it.

choices.label: Tell her you'll be there
choices.result: "Nine," she says again, and goes back to work like nothing happened.

effects.plan: Meet Juno at the flea market tomorrow morning

choices.label: Say you can't tomorrow
choices.result: "Your loss." She means it lightly. Mostly.

choices.label: Send a joke about the lamp
choices.result: "It's a very good lamp," she sends back, eventually. You are forgiven, on probation.

fail.result: The joke lands like a dropped tray. She leaves you on read, and at work she is exactly as friendly with you as with the dishwasher.

choices.label: Apologise
choices.result: "Noted." She doesn't do second chances out loud. She does them quietly, eventually.

scriptedScenes.title: Last call
scriptedScenes.opening: The last night of your two-week trial. Your phone buzzes: Priya. "Get in here." At the Velvet Room she rings the bell for last orders and looks straight at you.

choices.label: Take the job
choices.result: Priya nods like she knew. "Monday. Don't be late."

choices.label: Hand back the apron
choices.result: Priya takes it and, for once, has nothing dry to say. "Come in as a customer, then."

scriptedScenes.title: The Wurlitzer wakes
scriptedScenes.opening: The record is an old torch song, piano-led, slightly warped. Juno freezes with a glass in her hand. At the piano, Theo stops playing and just listens.

choices.label: Ask Juno about her mum
choices.result: She talks for twenty minutes, mid-shift, while Priya covers the taps without being asked. When she is done she squeezes your wrist once.

choices.label: Ask Theo to play along
choices.result: He finds the key by the second verse. For three minutes the dead man and the living one play together, and nobody in the bar orders anything.

choices.label: Pull them both onto the floor
choices.result: It is ridiculous and brief and the regulars cheer. Juno steps on your foot; Theo laughs harder than you have ever heard him laugh.

fail.result: You get as far as holding out a hand before losing your nerve and turning it into a stretch. Juno notices, and is kind about it.

scriptedScenes.title: Two roads
scriptedScenes.opening: Madame Oyelaran lets go of your hand and taps the table twice, which apparently costs extra.

choices.label: Tip her a fiver
choices.result: She pockets it without looking. "Thursday," she adds. "Something happens on a Thursday."

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.result: "Everybody laughs," she says, already reaching for the next palm. You think about it all afternoon anyway.

scriptedScenes.title: Early limes
scriptedScenes.opening: The market is still setting up. Juno is two stalls ahead of you, eyeing the only good crate of limes.

choices.label: Race her to the crate
choices.result: You get a hand on it first. Juno swears, laughs, and pays for it anyway, "as a tip for the entertainment."

fail.result: She hip-checks you into the potatoes and wins by a lime. "Rematch whenever," she says, delighted.

choices.label: Offer to carry it
choices.result: "I had it." She lets you anyway, and grades every stallholder on the way back.

scriptedScenes.title: Swan duty
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo is on the canal wall, guitar case shut, splitting a bread roll with a swan that clearly runs the place.

choices.label: Ask how he and Gerald met
choices.result: It is a long story and a good one, and by the end Theo is talking with his hands. He has not done that around you before.

fail.result: You laugh at the wrong moment. Theo smiles anyway. "Everyone does. Gerald forgives you."

choices.label: Sit on the wall and feed Gerald
choices.result: Gerald tolerates you. Theo seems to take that as a reference.

scriptedScenes.title: The fish man owes her
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno is squared up to the fish stall over an invoice she has been chasing for a month.

choices.label: Stand next to her and stare him down
choices.result: Two of you is one too many for him. He pays in full. Juno splits it with you without being asked.

fail.result: You blink first. Juno gets half the money anyway, and elbows you. "Work on the stare."

choices.label: Sweet-talk him into paying
choices.result: He pays, and throws in a mackerel. Juno does not know whether to be impressed or annoyed. She settles on both.

fail.result: He is immune. Juno takes over and wins, but she remembers you tried.

scriptedScenes.title: Two coffees, no talking
scriptedScenes.opening: You bring two coffees to the canal. Theo takes his without looking up from his notebook.

choices.label: Say nothing. Just sit
choices.result: Twenty quiet minutes. When he leaves he touches your shoulder, like he is checking you are real.

choices.label: Ask about the song he keeps not finishing
choices.result: He shows you the notebook. Half a verse, crossed out four times. "It's about leaving. I haven't, yet."

modifiers.label: He trusted you with the song

fail.result: He closes the notebook gently. "Another time." It does not sound like no.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Theo might open up more once he trusts you a little.

scriptedScenes.title: Sunday papers
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno has the papers spread across the market café table and has saved you the crossword, already half-wrong in pen.

choices.label: Finish the crossword for her
choices.result: You fix her answers one by one. She pretends to be furious and puts her feet in your lap.

choices.label: Read her the worst horoscope aloud
choices.result: She does the voices back. The café owner asks you both to keep it down.

scriptedScenes.title: Verse two
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo meets you at the lock with the guitar already out.

choices.label: Listen with your eyes shut
choices.result: It is not worse. You tell him so. He plays it again to be sure.

choices.label: Hum the harmony
choices.result: You are flat, and he loves it, and writes it in.

scriptedScenes.title: Stock-take dare
scriptedScenes.opening: The cellar, clipboard, forty-eight bottles of something nobody orders. Juno holds up a stopwatch.

choices.label: Take the bet
choices.result: You win by one bottle. Juno demands a recount, loses it, and buys the round with bad grace and a grin.

fail.result: You do the bins. She supervises, heckling, and brings you a drink at the end.

choices.label: Offer to do it properly instead
choices.result: "Boring." She lets you anyway and it is, annoyingly, done right.

scriptedScenes.title: Harmony
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo is busking to a crowd of two and a pushchair.

choices.label: Sing it with him
choices.result: You hold the note. The crowd becomes eleven. Theo counts the case afterwards and gives you half.

fail.result: Your voice cracks on the high bit. The pushchair baby applauds. Theo cannot stop laughing, kindly.

choices.label: Work the crowd with his hat
choices.result: You shake the hat like a professional. The case fills. Theo looks at you over the guitar like you might stay.

scriptedScenes.title: Priya's clipboard
scriptedScenes.opening: Priya is doing next week's rota with the face of someone defusing a bomb.

choices.label: Fix the rota
choices.result: It takes you ten minutes. Priya reads it twice, then pins it up without a word. That is high praise.

fail.result: You make it worse. Priya fixes it over your shoulder and, oddly, seems to like you more for trying.

choices.label: Fetch the coffee
choices.result: "Correct answer." She tells you which regulars to be careful of while she drinks it.

scriptedScenes.title: Rain under the bridge
scriptedScenes.opening: The sky opens. You and Theo end up under the same bridge, very close, guitar case between your feet.

choices.label: Close the gap
choices.result: You step round the guitar case. Neither of you says anything. The rain does not stop for a long time and you are both glad.

fail.result: You half-step and stop. He notices, and smiles at the pavement. "Me too," he says.

choices.label: Hold your jacket over you both
choices.result: It is a very small jacket. That is the point.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Spend some quiet time with Theo first.

scriptedScenes.title: The back step
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno is on the back step on her break, eyes shut, face to the sun.

choices.label: Sit down closer than you need to
choices.result: She does not move over. Neither do you. When her break ends she is late for once.

fail.result: You sit a polite distance away. "Coward," she says, and shuffles closer herself.

choices.label: Ask what she is saving her tips for
choices.result: "None of your business." A pause. "Something with my name over the door."

scriptedScenes.title: Spare key
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno slides something across the bar with the change.

choices.label: Pocket it without a fuss
choices.result: "Good." She seems relieved you did not make it a thing. It is a thing.

choices.label: Give her yours back
choices.result: She looks at your key for a long second, then threads it onto hers.

scriptedScenes.title: Closing bet
scriptedScenes.opening: Last hour. Juno leans on the bar and nods at the couple by the window.

choices.label: Bet her a drink you can get them to
choices.result: You send over two drinks "from the bar". They leave together. Juno pays up and looks at you differently.

fail.result: They leave separately. Juno takes your fiver and buys you a drink with it.

choices.label: Take the fiver bet
choices.result: You lose. She is gracious about it for almost a minute.

scriptedScenes.title: Request slip
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo has a jam jar of request slips on the piano. Most say "Wonderwall".

choices.label: Request "something you wrote"
choices.result: He hesitates, then plays twelve bars of something unfinished and looks straight at you at the end of it.

fail.result: He laughs and plays Wonderwall at you, deliberately badly. It is a good sign.

choices.label: Write "Wonderwall"
choices.result: He plays it in a minor key, as a punishment. The room loves it.

scriptedScenes.title: Lock-in
scriptedScenes.opening: Priya has gone home. Juno locks the door, turns the music down, and pours two of the good stuff.

choices.label: Kiss her
choices.result: She was waiting for it; you can tell because she wins it. The good stuff goes flat on the bar.

modifiers.label: You've held your own with her

fail.result: You lean in and knock the glass. Juno catches it, then catches you by the collar. "Owed," she says. "Pay up soon."

choices.label: "Not while you are my boss for the night"
choices.result: Juno laughs, properly. "Then tomorrow I am not." She walks you to the door.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Things with Juno need to get charged first.

scriptedScenes.title: Night bus
scriptedScenes.opening: You catch the same night bus as Theo. Top deck, front seats, the city sliding past.

choices.label: Kiss him before the doors open
choices.result: He kisses you back, slowly, and the bus drives on with both of you still on it.

modifiers.label: You have sat in the quiet with him
He trusted you with the song

fail.result: You wait too long. He gets off, then turns and waves until the bus is round the corner.

choices.label: Ride to the end of the line with him
choices.result: You both miss your stops. You walk back together at two in the morning, talking the whole way.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: You and Theo need a moment first.

scriptedScenes.title: Her own place
scriptedScenes.opening: After close, Juno is sketching on the back of a beer mat: a bar, a door, a sign.

choices.label: Ask what she would call it
choices.result: "Last Orders." She has had the name for years. She tells you the whole menu before you finish your drink.

choices.label: Tell her she would be brilliant at it
choices.result: She rolls her eyes so hard it must hurt. Then she keeps the beer mat.

scriptedScenes.title: Set list
scriptedScenes.opening: Theo passes you tonight's set list. The last song has no title, just your initial.

choices.label: Keep it on the list
choices.result: He plays it last. The room goes quiet in the good way.

choices.label: Move it to the middle, where it is safer
choices.result: He grins. "Coward." He plays it last anyway.

scriptedScenes.title: Priya notices
scriptedScenes.opening: Priya throws something at you across the bar. You catch it. That alone seems to be the test.

choices.label: Try it on
choices.result: It fits. Priya pretends not to be pleased.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Rank up Nerve and someone might notice.

scriptedScenes.title: A good listener
scriptedScenes.opening: Between songs Theo presses a guitar pick into your hand.

choices.label: Keep it on you
choices.result: It lives in your pocket from now on. You catch yourself turning it over when people talk.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Rank up Empathy and Theo might notice.

scriptedScenes.title: The good pour
scriptedScenes.opening: Juno waves you behind the bar during a lull.

choices.label: Learn her pour
choices.result: Third try, you get it. Juno nods once, which from her is a medal.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Rank up Charm and Juno might let you behind her bar.

scriptedScenes.title: Quiz team
scriptedScenes.opening: The Thursday quiz team is a man down. Priya volunteers you before you can hide.

choices.label: Play
choices.result: Second place, which the team treats as a moral victory. They give you the lucky pen.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Rank up Wit and the quiz team might want you.

scriptedScenes.title: Take the stage
scriptedScenes.opening: The act has cancelled. Priya looks at the empty stage, then at you.

choices.label: Get up there
choices.result: Ten minutes turns into twenty. Juno heckles; Theo plays you off. From now on they both know you will.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Get Bold and Priya has a job for you.

scriptedScenes.title: Priya's bad night
scriptedScenes.opening: Priya is in the staff room with the lights off.

choices.label: Stay until she is ready to go back out
choices.result: Ten minutes. She goes back out and runs the best Friday of the fortnight. She owes you, and she says so.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Priya might talk to someone perceptive enough.

scriptedScenes.title: On the house
scriptedScenes.opening: A regular sends you a drink. Then another. Juno is keeping count, and it annoys her.

choices.label: Share them with Juno
choices.result: She drinks them with you and stops being annoyed about halfway through the second one.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Get Magnetic and the regulars take notice.

scriptedScenes.title: Quiz captain
scriptedScenes.opening: The quiz team makes you captain by show of hands. You win the keg.

choices.label: Give the first pint to Theo and Juno
choices.result: The whole bar toasts the team. Juno buys the next round, which she never does.

scriptedScenes.offerHint: Get Quick and the quiz team wants a captain.

scriptedScenes.title: Theo clocks it
scriptedScenes.opening: You come in and Juno lights up before she can stop it. Theo sees the whole thing from the end of the bar.

choices.label: Own it
choices.result: You don't deny it. Juno goes pink and pretends to wipe the same glass three times. Theo raises his drink to you both.

fail.result: You open your mouth to say it and order a lemonade instead. Theo will never let this go. Juno looks, if anything, charmed.

choices.label: Turn it back on Theo
choices.result: "Funny, I was going to ask you the same thing." Theo chokes on his drink. Juno laughs and slides you one on the house.

scriptedScenes.title: Right of way
scriptedScenes.opening: A swan has planted itself across the towpath and is looking at you like you owe it money. A kid on the bridge is filming.

choices.label: Stare it down
choices.result: The swan blinks first. The kid on the bridge cheers. Somewhere, a legend is born.

fail.result: The swan wins. You take the long way round, pursued by a small child's laughter.

choices.label: Offer it half your sandwich
choices.result: It accepts the sandwich with terrible dignity and lets you pass.

fail.result: It takes the sandwich, and then your pride.

choices.label: Take the long way round
choices.result: Discretion. The swan watches you go.

scriptedScenes.title: Finders
scriptedScenes.opening: A fat wallet on the cobbles by the flower stall: cash, a library card, and a photo of a very old dog.

choices.label: Track down the owner
choices.result: Library card, dog, flower stall: you find him at the cheese van. He insists on a reward and will not hear otherwise.

fail.result: You hand it in at the market office. The clerk looks at you like you took something.

choices.label: Pocket the cash, post the wallet
choices.result: Forty quid richer. The dog in the photo keeps looking at you.

choices.label: Hand it in
choices.result: Done. You feel correct, if unrewarded.

scriptedScenes.title: Last warning
scriptedScenes.opening: A regular has had four too many and is leaning over the bar to tell Juno what she should smile about.

choices.label: Step between him and Juno
choices.result: You take his arm, walk him to the door and hold it. He goes. Juno says "I had it," then pours you a drink she doesn't ring up.

fail.result: He shoves you into the ice well. Juno removes him in four words, then checks you are all right, which she will later deny.

choices.label: Talk him down
choices.result: You ask about his day until he forgets he was angry, then put him in a taxi. Priya nods at you once. That nod is worth a lot.

fail.result: He decides you are his best friend and will not leave without you. Priya handles it. "Nice try."

choices.label: Fetch Priya
choices.result: Priya handles it in thirty seconds. Juno watches you the whole time and says nothing.

interests.label: Likes being out-played; wants someone who takes the lead and means it
Needs it slow, and needs to be asked when he goes quiet

endings.name: Last Orders
endings.text: Hollis Street, a month later. The sign is hand-painted and slightly crooked: LAST ORDERS. Juno stands you at the end of her bar, pours the first drink, and does not charge you. "Staff," she says. "Obviously."

endings.name: Last one out
endings.text: Chairs up, till counted, lights off. Juno holds the door and doesn't lock it until you are through it. "Same time tomorrow," she says. It isn't a question anymore.

endings.name: The ending
endings.text: Theo plays the song after midnight, finished. He doesn't say who it's about. He looks at you the whole time he doesn't say it.

endings.name: Closing time
endings.text: Theo plays other people's songs all night and leaves by the back door. Some things a fortnight can't fix. Priya pours you one on the house and says nothing, which is the kindest thing she has done.

endings.name: A regular
endings.text: Two weeks, a few scars, a stool at the end of the bar with your name on it. Nobody fell for you this time. The Velvet Room did.

objects.name: the creaking floorboard
objects.description: It lifts with a butter knife. Under it: dust, a bus ticket from 1994, and room for whatever somebody meant to come back for.

objects.name: the launderette noticeboard
objects.description: Lost cat, guitar lessons, and a faded flyer: "The Velvet Room, open mic every Thursday since 1987."

objects.name: the wardrobe mirror
objects.description: You practise a smile. It is getting better.
objects.useText: You give yourself the pep talk out loud. The neighbour bangs on the wall, which counts as applause.

objects.name: the photo wall
objects.description: Forty years of staff nights. In one, a young woman with Juno's jaw pours a drink for a pianist with Theo's hands. Neither of them has mentioned this.

objects.name: the ice machine
objects.description: It rattles like a bag of teeth. Things fall behind it and stay there.

objects.name: the dead jukebox
objects.description: A Wurlitzer, unplugged since before Juno. The service panel has a tiny brass lock marked JB.
objects.useText: The key turns. The Wurlitzer shudders, glows amber, and drops a record nobody has heard in this room for twenty years. The whole bar goes quiet.

objects.name: the record crate
objects.description: Fifty pence a record, no refunds. Near the bottom, in a paper sleeve, a single with green ink on the label.

objects.name: the fortune-teller's booth
objects.description: Madame Oyelaran reads palms for a pound. The sign says CASH ONLY, NO REFUNDS ON DESTINY.
objects.useText: She holds your hand a long time. "Two roads, both after midnight. One sings, one pours. Pick before the fortnight ends, or the city picks for you."

objects.name: the lock-keeper's hut
objects.description: Boarded up, but the window box still has a row of rusted key hooks and a loose brick underneath.

objects.name: the graffiti under the bridge
objects.description: Decades of initials. Low down, nearly scrubbed out: "M + A, VR, 1987". Someone has recently drawn a small piano beside it.

moments.text: A soggy note is snagged in the reeds. {amount}, once it dries.
Last winter's coat pocket gives up {amount} and a bus ticket.
Someone has tucked {amount} under a beer mat with "for the new one" on it.
The fruit seller swears she short-changed you last week and presses {amount} into your hand.
A cyclist nearly clips you on the towpath. You don't even flinch.
You talk a stallholder down to half price on a lamp you don't want, purely on principle.
A regular tells you about his divorce in full. You listen properly, which is rarer than it sounds.
You practise your smile in the hall mirror until it stops looking like a threat.
{name} jogs past on the towpath, doubles back, and falls into step with you.
moments.line: Don't tell anyone I jog. It ruins the mystique.

moments.text: {name} is at the record stall, pretending not to have seen you, then very obviously seeing you.
moments.line: I was — this is — hi. Do you like Coltrane?

moments.text: {name} is on a bench with a textbook and a thermos, and waves you over.
moments.line: Quiz me. Please. Anything on tort law.

moments.text: {name} is queueing at the coffee van and buys you one without asking.
moments.line: You look like a flat white. That is a compliment.

moments.text: {name} is sitting on your front step with two coffees.
moments.line: I was in the area. I am never in the area.

moments.text: {name} is on your doorstep holding a cassette like a bouquet.
moments.line: I made you a tape. People still do that. I do that.

phoneMessages.text: Market run. The lime man is flirting with me for a discount again. Come be my bodyguard?

replies.text: Let him. We need the discount.

phoneMessages.text: Playing by the lock. The duck is back. I need a second opinion on the bridge verse.

replies.text: Save me the good bit of wall.
The duck is a harsh critic. Good luck.

phoneMessages.text: Can you come and exist near the bar for an hour? Juno is in a Mood and I have a chapter to finish.

replies.text: Tell her I said hi. From a safe distance.

phoneMessages.text: Found your present. Don't make a habit of being nice, people will talk.

replies.text: It was nothing. It was a little bit something.

phoneMessages.text: I've put it where I can see it from the piano. Is that weird. It's weird.

replies.text: Not weird. Play me something about it.

phoneMessages.text: You gone quiet on me, or just busy being mysterious?

replies.text: Busy. Missing the bar, though. Missing you, a bit.

phoneMessages.text: Wrote a verse about someone who stopped coming to the bar. Hypothetically.
